note: landsAt is required: a pending notice that does not say when the reduction takes effect tells the subject nothing they can act on before it does.
actionId is required: without it the subject cannot follow the action to learn whether it was cancelled or landed.
code is a closed set; `removed` is a membership removal (vtc/members/removal-notice), not a reduction of authority.
Unknown top-level member — additionalProperties: false. The notice carries no veto or objection handle: the subject cannot block the reduction.
actionId shorter than the shared ActionId minimum — a guessable id would let any subject probe other actions.
landsAt must be an RFC 3339 date-time, not a relative expression.
